value.rationale: The two endpoints are distinct canonical 14-vertex Catalan solids, and the continuum of radial deformations is a motivated stable-topology question. The exact integral barcode survives a nontrivial intervening 3-dimensional thickening, and the last S6 death has a sharp t=sqrt(3) switch from axis- to cube-corner-antipodal mechanism. This parameterized structural result is not a routine isolated endpoint restatement, although it does not assert arbitrary deformation stability.
